newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 3.3 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 3.3 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed a special issue of six-month, floater coupon T-bills worth 3.3 billion levs and yielding 112.47 percent to maturity, the central bank said.
The coupon was set equal to the central bank's main interest rate for the period to maturity. The issue was dated April 7 when a new lower main rate goes into force.
The central bank on Thursday said it had decided to cut the main rate to 17.14 percent monthly from the current 18 percent, effective from Monday. @
In line with its usual practice the central bank did not say with which financial intitution or institutions the issue was placed.
Details of the issue follow. Price percent of par.
